This '''starship''', a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]], served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
This starship participated in the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]], where it was commanded by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TJ-912/Legends|TJ-912]]. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the Confederation used this battle in an attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] his disciple [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and ordered TJ-912 to fire upon the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] that Ventress was on and withdraw from the system. The tactical droid complied with the order, and this starship was used to destroy the command ship; Ventress, however, escaped.
